# Command reference

This page is generated from the exact Clap command model used by the shipped
`colosseum-cli` executable. Conceptual guidance and examples live in the
[CLI guide](README.md).

## `colosseum-cli`

```text
A headless harness for inspecting, testing and comparing ordinary UCI chess-engine executables.

Usage: colosseum-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  capabilities  Print detected topology, restrictions and affinity support
  match         Run a fixed number of games between two ordinary UCI engines
  sprt          Run a finite pair-atomic sequential probability ratio test
  spsa          Tune numeric UCI options with durable pair-atomic SPSA
  nps           Measure fixed-node search speed using harness monotonic wall time
  calibrate     Measure identical-binary symmetry under representative match conditions
  engine        Inspect or compliance-check an ordinary UCI executable
  book          Inspect, verify, hash or deterministically slice an opening book
  stats         Replay match statistics from the strongest available evidence source
  suite         Run fixed-work searches over an EPD or FEN position set
  tournament    Plan or run a multi-engine round-robin or gauntlet tournament
  gauntlet      Convenience alias for the same tournament gauntlet planner
  self-test     Verify this exact executable's protocol, process and persistence paths
  status        Read the official state of any CLI run without modifying it
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `colosseum-cli match`

```text
Run a fixed number of games between two ordinary UCI engines

Usage: colosseum-cli match [OPTIONS] --games <GAMES> <ENGINE_A> <ENGINE_B>

Arguments:
  <ENGINE_A>
          Path to engine A's UCI executable

  <ENGINE_B>
          Path to engine B's UCI executable

Options:
      --games <GAMES>
          Exact number of games to play; this command never stops early

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --a-label <A_LABEL>


      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --a-engine-arg <A_ARGUMENTS>


      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --a-cwd <A_CWD>


      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --a-env <KEY=VALUE>


      --a-option <NAME=VALUE>


      --a-button <NAME>


      --a-cores <LIST>


      --a-movetime-ms <A_MOVETIME_MS>


      --a-base-ms <A_BASE_MS>


      --a-increment-ms <A_INCREMENT_MS>


      --a-nodes <A_NODES>


      --a-depth <A_DEPTH>


      --a-margin-ms <A_MARGIN_MS>
          [default: 2000]

      --b-label <B_LABEL>


      --b-engine-arg <B_ARGUMENTS>


      --b-cwd <B_CWD>


      --b-env <KEY=VALUE>


      --b-option <NAME=VALUE>


      --b-button <NAME>


      --b-cores <LIST>


      --b-movetime-ms <B_MOVETIME_MS>


      --b-base-ms <B_BASE_MS>


      --b-increment-ms <B_INCREMENT_MS>


      --b-nodes <B_NODES>


      --b-depth <B_DEPTH>


      --b-margin-ms <B_MARGIN_MS>
          [default: 2000]

      --ponder
          Let engines think on the opponent's clock through the UCI ponder protocol

      --no-draw-adjudication
          Disable the default conservative draw adjudication

      --draw-move <DRAW_MOVE>
          [default: 40]

      --draw-moves <DRAW_MOVES>
          [default: 8]

      --draw-score-cp <DRAW_SCORE_CP>
          [default: 10]

      --no-resign-adjudication
          Disable the default two-sided resignation adjudication

      --one-sided-resign-adjudication
          Use only the losing engine's evaluations for resignation adjudication

      --resign-moves <RESIGN_MOVES>
          [default: 3]

      --resign-score-cp <RESIGN_SCORE_CP>
          [default: 600]

      --max-moves <MAX_MOVES>
          Draw after this many full moves; omitted means no maximum-move cap

      --max-engine-faults <MAX_ENGINE_FAULTS>
          Invalidate after more engine-attributable faults than this value

          [default: 0]

      --max-time-losses <MAX_TIME_LOSSES>
          Invalidate after more time losses than this value

          [default: 0]

      --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>
          Number of games allowed to run at once

          [default: 1]

      --cores-per-engine <CORES_PER_ENGINE>
          Physical cores allocated separately to each engine in each game slot

          [default: 1]

      --placement <PLACEMENT>
          CPU placement: off, auto, or an explicit logical CPU list

          [default: off]

      --headroom-cores <HEADROOM_CORES>
          Whole physical cores left free when placement is auto

          [default: 2]

      --memory-budget-mb <MEMORY_BUDGET_MB>
          Trusted hard budget for the two engines' configured Hash memory

      --book <BOOK>
          Optional EPD or PGN opening book; format is inferred from the extension

      --book-order <BOOK_ORDER>
          Opening order within the book

          [default: sequential]
          [possible values: sequential, random]

      --book-start <BOOK_START>
          Zero-based first opening after ordering

          [default: 0]

      --book-plies <BOOK_PLIES>
          PGN half-moves to pre-play; EPD positions ignore this value

      --seed <SEED>
          Master seed for every random choice; generated and reported when omitted

      --dir <RUN_DIRECTORY>
          Self-contained run directory; an existing matching directory resumes

      --restart
          Archive an existing --dir and start a fresh run there

      --progress-interval-secs <PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SECS>
          Seconds between live progress reports on standard error

          [default: 10]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli sprt`

```text
Run a finite pair-atomic sequential probability ratio test

Usage: colosseum-cli sprt [OPTIONS] --max-pairs <MAX_PAIRS> [ENGINE_A] [ENGINE_B]

          Path to engine A; omit both engine paths when using --apply

  [ENGINE_B]
          Path to engine B; omit both engine paths when using --apply

      --apply <RESULT_JSON>
          Completed SPSA result.json whose original/tuned vectors form the gate

          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

          Use this executable instead of the path recorded by the SPSA result

          Proceed with --apply despite an executable SHA-256 mismatch

          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

          Required finite cap; reaching it without a boundary is inconclusive

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --preset <PRESET>
          Named starting design; every field remains overridable

          [possible values: gainer, simplify]

          [possible values: normalized, logistic]

      --elo0 <ELO0>
```

## `colosseum-cli spsa plan`

```text
Report the exact gain schedule and factual workload without launching an engine

Usage: colosseum-cli spsa plan [OPTIONS] --tune <TUNE> --r-end <R_END>

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --tune <TUNE>
          Ordered TOML parameter vector whose schedule should be planned

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --r-end <R_END>
          Terminal SPSA gain ratio shared by every tuned parameter

      --iterations <ITERATIONS>
          Number of SPSA centre updates in the primary horizon

          [default: 5000]

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --games-per-iteration <GAMES_PER_ITERATION>
          Complete games in each pair-atomic mini-match

          [default: 32]

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>
          Number of games expected to run concurrently within each iteration

          [default: 1]

      --compare-iterations <COMPARISON_HORIZONS>
          Compare cost and first/final gain values at another horizon; repeatable

      --seconds-per-game-low <SECONDS_PER_GAME_LOW>
          Lower end-to-end seconds-per-game assumption for a wall-time range

      --seconds-per-game-high <SECONDS_PER_GAME_HIGH>
          Upper end-to-end seconds-per-game assumption for a wall-time range

      --pilot-game-seconds <PILOT_GAME_SECONDS>
          Observed end-to-end duration of one pilot game; repeat for a sample range

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli nps`

```text
Measure fixed-node search speed using harness monotonic wall time

Usage: colosseum-cli nps [OPTIONS] --nodes <NODES> <EXECUTABLE>

Arguments:
  <EXECUTABLE>
          Path to the UCI engine executable

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --label <LABEL>
          Optional display label; it is not engine identity

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --engine-arg <ARGUMENTS>
          Argument passed to the engine process; repeat for multiple arguments

      --cwd <CWD>
          Working directory used when launching the engine

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --env <KEY=VALUE>
          Environment override as KEY=VALUE; repeat for multiple variables

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --option <NAME=VALUE>
          UCI option as NAME=VALUE; repeat for multiple options

      --button <NAME>
          Trigger a UCI button option by name; repeat for multiple buttons

      --cores <LIST>
          Allocated logical CPUs, for example 0,2-4 or Windows groups 0:0-3,1:0-3

      --nodes <NODES>
          Fixed number of nodes requested from the engine

      --against <AGAINST>
          Primary executable for arm B; enables A/B comparison

      --a-build <A_BUILDS>
          Additional executable in arm A; repeat for pooled builds

      --b-build <B_BUILDS>
          Additional executable in arm B; repeat for pooled builds

      --self-pair
          Compare the primary executable with itself instead of using --against

      --positions <POSITIONS>
          UCI FEN to search; repeat for a suite. Omit to use startpos

      --move <MOVES>
          Move following the selected position; repeat to provide a move list

      --repetitions <REPETITIONS>
          Measured repetitions of the complete position/build schedule

          [default: 5]

      --warmup <WARMUP>
          Unreported repetitions run before measurement

          [default: 1]

      --state <STATE>
          Restart per sample (cold) or retain each engine process (warm)

          [default: warm]
          [possible values: cold, warm]

      --seed <SEED>
          Master seed for position, pair and warm-up scheduling

          [default: 0]

      --bootstrap-samples <BOOTSTRAP_SAMPLES>
          Bootstrap resamples used for each arm's median confidence interval

          [default: 10000]

      --self-tolerance-percent <SELF_TOLERANCE_PERCENT>
          Maximum absolute self-pair median difference before warning

          [default: 0.5]

      --scale-threads <1,2,4,8>
          Comma-separated search-thread counts; enables a pinned scaling sweep

      --threads-option <THREADS_OPTION>
          Advertised UCI spin option controlling engine search threads

      --hash-policy <HASH_POLICY>
          Hash allocation rule used by a scaling sweep

          [default: fixed-total]
          [possible values: fixed-total, per-thread]

      --hash-mb <HASH_MB>
          Hash MiB: total under fixed-total, or per thread under per-thread

          [default: 16]

      --hash-option <HASH_OPTION>
          Advertised UCI spin option controlling hash size

          [default: Hash]

      --deadline-ms <DEADLINE_MS>
          Maximum wall time allowed for the fixed-node search

          [default: 60000]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli engine inspect`

```text
Print UCI identity and the option schema advertised during handshake

Usage: colosseum-cli engine inspect [OPTIONS] <EXECUTABLE>

Arguments:
  <EXECUTABLE>
          Path to the UCI engine executable

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --label <LABEL>
          Optional display label; it is not engine identity

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --engine-arg <ARGUMENTS>
          Argument passed to the engine process; repeat for multiple arguments

      --cwd <CWD>
          Working directory used when launching the engine

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --env <KEY=VALUE>
          Environment override as KEY=VALUE; repeat for multiple variables

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --option <NAME=VALUE>
          UCI option as NAME=VALUE; repeat for multiple options

      --button <NAME>
          Trigger a UCI button option by name; repeat for multiple buttons

      --cores <LIST>
          Allocated logical CPUs, for example 0,2-4 or Windows groups 0:0-3,1:0-3

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli book`

```text
Inspect, verify, hash or deterministically slice an opening book

Usage: colosseum-cli book [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  slice   Write a deterministic canonical EPD subset
  hash    Compute the SHA-256 of the exact input bytes
  stats   Report parsed entry, uniqueness and ply statistics
  verify  Strictly account for every candidate and reject malformed entries
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli book slice`

```text
Write a deterministic canonical EPD subset

Usage: colosseum-cli book slice [OPTIONS] --count <COUNT> <INPUT> <OUTPUT>

Arguments:
  <INPUT>
          EPD or PGN input path

  <OUTPUT>
          Canonical EPD output path

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>
          Override format detection from the file extension

          [possible values: epd, pgn]

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --plies <PLIES>
          PGN half-moves retained per game

          [default: 8]

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --start <START>
          Number of ordered entries skipped before writing

          [default: 0]

      --count <COUNT>
          Maximum entries written

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --order <ORDER>
          Sequential file order or named-stream random order

          [default: sequential]
          [possible values: sequential, random]

      --seed <SEED>
          Master seed used by random order

          [default: 0]

      --force
          Permit replacing an existing output file

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

```text
Plan prospective fixed-N or expected SPRT length

  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli stats plan fixed`

```text
Estimate fixed-N pairs under explicit distribution assumptions

Usage: colosseum-cli stats plan fixed [OPTIONS] --objective <OBJECTIVE> --model <MODEL> --effect-or-margin <EFFECT_OR_MARGIN> --distribution <DISTRIBUTION>

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --objective <OBJECTIVE>
          [possible values: difference, equivalence]

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --model <MODEL>
          [possible values: normalized, logistic]

      --effect-or-margin <EFFECT_OR_MARGIN>
          Positive effect (difference) or symmetric margin (equivalence), in selected Elo model

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --significance <SIGNIFICANCE>
          [default: 0.05]

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --power <POWER>
          [default: 0.8]

      --distribution <DISTRIBUTION>
          Five comma-separated pentanomial probabilities summing to one

      --observed-pentanomial <OBSERVED_PENTANOMIAL>
          Optional five comma-separated observed bin counts for achieved resolution

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

```text
Options:

          [default: 0.05]

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --beta <BETA>
          [default: 0.05]

      --distribution <DISTRIBUTION>
          Five comma-separated assumed true pentanomial probabilities

      --simulations <SIMULATIONS>
          [default: 1000]

      --max-pairs <MAX_PAIRS>


      --seed <SEED>
          [default: 0]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli suite`

```text
Run fixed-work searches over an EPD or FEN position set

Usage: colosseum-cli suite [OPTIONS] <EXECUTABLE> <INPUT>

Arguments:
  <EXECUTABLE>
          Path to the UCI engine executable

  <INPUT>
          EPD or line-oriented FEN position set

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --label <LABEL>
          Optional display label; it is not engine identity

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --engine-arg <ARGUMENTS>
          Argument passed to the engine process; repeat for multiple arguments

      --cwd <CWD>
          Working directory used when launching the engine

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --env <KEY=VALUE>
          Environment override as KEY=VALUE; repeat for multiple variables

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --option <NAME=VALUE>
          UCI option as NAME=VALUE; repeat for multiple options

      --button <NAME>
          Trigger a UCI button option by name; repeat for multiple buttons

      --cores <LIST>
          Allocated logical CPUs, for example 0,2-4 or Windows groups 0:0-3,1:0-3

      --format <FORMAT>
          Override input format detection from the extension

          [possible values: epd, fen]

      --nodes <NODES>
          Fixed nodes per position

      --movetime-ms <MOVETIME_MS>
          Fixed search time per position

      --depth <DEPTH>
          Fixed search depth per position

      --deadline-ms <DEADLINE_MS>
          Safety deadline per position; derived from the limit when omitted

      --baseline <BASELINE>
          Previous compatible suite result.json to compare

      --dir <RUN_DIRECTORY>
          Self-contained run directory; an existing matching directory resumes

      --restart
          Archive an existing --dir and start a fresh run there

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli tournament`

```text
Plan or run a multi-engine round-robin or gauntlet tournament

Usage: colosseum-cli tournament [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  plan  Print the exact static schedule without launching engines
  run   Play the schedule, persist every game, and write ratings and CSV files
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli tournament plan`

```text
Print the exact static schedule without launching engines

Usage: colosseum-cli tournament plan [OPTIONS] --engine <ENGINES>

Options:
      --engine <ENGINES>
          UCI executable in selection/seed order; repeat at least twice

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --format <FORMAT>
          Round-robin or gauntlet schedule

          [possible values: round-robin, gauntlet]

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --seeds <SEEDS>
          Leading engines treated as gauntlet seeds

          [default: 1]

      --cycles <CYCLES>
          Repetitions of the complete format schedule

          [default: 1]

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --games-per-pair <GAMES_PER_PAIR>
          Games per encounter, alternating colours

          [default: 2]

      --rating <RATINGS>
          Initial rating aligned with each --engine; defaults to 1500

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `colosseum-cli tournament run`

```text
Play the schedule, persist every game, and write ratings and CSV files

Usage: colosseum-cli tournament run [OPTIONS] --engine <ENGINES>

Options:
      --engine <ENGINES>
          UCI executable in selection/seed order; repeat at least twice

      --json
          Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout

      --dry-run
          Resolve and print configuration/invocations without launching an engine

      --format <FORMAT>
          Round-robin or gauntlet schedule

          [possible values: round-robin, gauntlet]

      --run-file <PATH>
          Load reusable command options from an inheritable TOML run file

      --seeds <SEEDS>
          Leading engines treated as gauntlet seeds

          [default: 1]

      --cycles <CYCLES>
          Repetitions of the complete format schedule

          [default: 1]

      --unset-run-option <LONG_NAME>
          Remove one inherited run-file option before applying CLI arguments

      --games-per-pair <GAMES_PER_PAIR>
          Games per encounter, alternating colours

          [default: 2]

      --rating <RATINGS>
          Initial rating aligned with each --engine; defaults to 1500

      --label <LABELS>
          Display labels aligned with --engine; omit all to use file stems

      --engine-arg <ARGUMENTS>
          Argument passed to every engine process; repeat as needed

      --engine-arg-at <INDEX:ARG>
          Argument for one engine as one-based INDEX:ARG

      --cwd <CWD>
          Working directory used for every engine process

      --engine-cwd <INDEX:PATH>
          Working directory override for one engine as one-based INDEX:PATH

      --env <KEY=VALUE>
          Environment override applied to every engine as KEY=VALUE

      --engine-env <INDEX:KEY=VALUE>
          Environment override for one engine as INDEX:KEY=VALUE

      --option <NAME=VALUE>
          UCI option applied to every engine as NAME=VALUE

      --engine-option <INDEX:NAME=VALUE>
          UCI option for one engine as INDEX:NAME=VALUE

      --button <NAME>
          Trigger this UCI button on every engine

      --engine-button <INDEX:NAME>
          Trigger a UCI button on one engine as INDEX:NAME

      --movetime-ms <MOVETIME_MS>


      --base-ms <BASE_MS>


      --increment-ms <INCREMENT_MS>


      --nodes <NODES>


      --depth <DEPTH>


      --margin-ms <MARGIN_MS>
          [default: 2000]

      --ponder
          Let engines think on the opponent's clock through the UCI ponder protocol

      --no-draw-adjudication


      --draw-move <DRAW_MOVE>
          [default: 40]

      --draw-moves <DRAW_MOVES>
          [default: 8]

      --draw-score-cp <DRAW_SCORE_CP>
          [default: 10]

      --no-resign-adjudication


      --one-sided-resign-adjudication
          Use only the losing engine's evaluations for resignation adjudication

      --resign-moves <RESIGN_MOVES>
          [default: 3]

      --resign-score-cp <RESIGN_SCORE_CP>
          [default: 600]

      --max-moves <MAX_MOVES>


      --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>
          Number of games allowed to run at once

          [default: 1]

      --cores-per-engine <CORES_PER_ENGINE>
          [default: 1]

      --placement <PLACEMENT>
          [default: off]

      --headroom-cores <HEADROOM_CORES>
          [default: 2]

      --memory-budget-mb <MEMORY_BUDGET_MB>


      --book <BOOK>


      --book-order <BOOK_ORDER>
          [default: sequential]
          [possible values: sequential, random]

      --book-start <BOOK_START>
          [default: 0]

      --book-plies <BOOK_PLIES>


      --seed <SEED>


      --anchor <ANCHOR>
          One-based --engine index whose prior rating fixes the Elo scale

      --max-engine-faults <MAX_ENGINE_FAULTS>
          Invalidate only after more engine faults than this; omitted is non-strict

      --dir <RUN_DIRECTORY>


      --restart


  -h, --help
          Print help
```
